reasoning: A clear horizontal battery with a partial fill and a lightning bolt indicating charging. It fits real-world tasks about charging gear, packing power banks, or buying/replacing batteries, though its distinctiveness is lowered by near-identical icons for other battery charge percentages.

pass1.ambiguity: Closely resembles other battery level or charging status icons in the same icon family; the exact fill level (around 30%) is an interface status distinction rather than a task distinction.

distinguishing: Shows the thickest solid black fill on the left side (~30% charged) compared to the empty and barely-filled charging battery icons, but is functionally interchangeable with both for representing any battery or charging task.
